After dinner, checks for shift swaps
After reading you will know what to do first

Companion Animal Travel Desk page: first review matters because animal travel begins with accurate intake, calm handling, and careful matching of service to species and condition. New staff must remember that each case is handled with patience and respect, since fear in an animal can increase stress for the traveler and for the crew. The desk exists to confirm that every booking is suitable before the pet reaches the airport process.

Begin by reading the reservation record in full and then compare it with the traveler's verbal request. If the traveler mentions a rabbit, place the required age guidance in the record before moving on. If the traveler brings a bird, confirm the applicable fee in the same way and make sure the traveler understands that the charge is part of the service review. For a small dog, verify the crate dimensions and check that the carrier supports safe movement without crowding. <<FACT F076>> <<FACT F059>> <<FACT F068>>

When speaking with travelers, use a steady tone and simple language. Avoid rushed instructions, and do not assume that the traveler knows kennel standards or animal comfort needs. Ask for any missing care details, including feeding notes, handling preferences, and signs of nervous behavior. If a pet appears tense, pause the process and refer the matter to the senior coordinator rather than pressing ahead. Humane service means reducing distress while still keeping the travel file complete.

Document every confirmation clearly so the next colleague can continue without confusion. Make sure the file shows what was accepted, what still needs review, and what the traveler was told. This desk supports safe travel by combining accuracy, courtesy, and restraint in every contact.

Remember that careful notes, calm handling, and correct screening protect the animal, the traveler, and Aurelia Skyways.
